title: Invert Binary Tree
prompt:
Invert a binary tree (mirror it left-right) and return its root.

**Example**: `[4,2,7,1,3,6,9]` → `[4,7,2,9,6,3,1]`.

The gentlest possible DFS: swap children, recurse into both.
hints: Swap `root.left` and `root.right` (needs a temp), then recurse on both children — or recurse first; either order works.

solution.explanation: O(n) time, O(height) stack. Every tree problem's skeleton in miniature: null base case, local work, recurse into children.
